body.message:
Hi,
I hear you on the "holiday home vs hotel" distinction — but that's not the point.
The point is simple: when a guest reports a health and safety emergency at 11pm with a 4-month-old baby, the bare minimum is to acknowledge the situation and confirm someone is looking into it. That costs nothing. Instead, I spent the night with zero response from your side.
You mention the building reception is available 24/7. That may be true — but no one told me to contact them during the emergency. What I did receive, at check-in, was a message from Afifa (Quality Assurance Manager) inviting me to reach out on WhatsApp +971 52 175 0940 or by email. I tried. No response. That number either didn't ring or was only monitored 9am to 9pm — which directly contradicts what you're now telling me.
So to be clear: the emergency contact you provided did not work. The building reception was never mentioned. And your team only responded 12 hours later.
I have already booked alternative accommodation. I am not coming back to the original unit. I am requesting a full refund of the original reservation plus reimbursement of the 700 AED I spent this morning — and I expect a direct response on this, not a redirect to Airbnb.
